title: SANE: Automated Scorer-Specific Metamorphic Testing for LLM Judges
title_zh: SANE：面向 LLM 评审者的自动化评分器特定蜕变测试

paragraphs.en: LLM judges increasingly mediate benchmark evaluation, model selection, data curation, and training. 1 1 1 The authors used large language model tools for manuscript editing and software implementation. The authors reviewed and take responsibility for all text, code, analyses, claims, and citations. Their decisions are useful only when each judge responds reliably to changes affecting its scoring criterion. Existing methods for reliability testing perturb inputs with known expected effects on judge scores. Prominent LLM-judge testing harnesses combine human-authored perturbation recipes with synthetic test generation, leaving scorer-specific recipe ideation outside the automated pipeline. This limits their use to fixed perturbations and pre-assumed scorer types. We introduce Sane , an agent-based framework that encodes behavioral requirements for stochastic evaluators as reusable agent instructions. Given a scorer specification, implementation, and representative inputs, the pipeline first identifies scorer-specific capabilities, then automatically derives perturbation recipes and expected score relations for each. Sane also defines a scorer-independent validation framework for generated judge tests. It determines whether each recipe agrees with scorer intent and whether each instantiated case realizes the recipe and supports its expected relation. Because Sane generates a recipe inventory tailored to each scorer, the number of aligned recipes grows as scorers are added. Across five domains, Sane produces 3.7 times as many validated test families as the Judge Reliability Harness ( Jrh ) at comparable end-to-end validity and detects scorer deficiencies in every domain, including professionalism and toxicity, where Jrh detects none. On faithfulness, Sane achieves strong human alignment in judge ranking: its test-suite scores rank 11 judge models consistently with human-labeled FaithBench performance (Spearman ρ = 0.852 \rho=0.852 ), while Jrh does not ( ρ = 0.100 \rho=0.100 ).
paragraphs.zh: LLM 裁判在基准评测、模型选择、数据筛选与训练中发挥着日益重要的中介作用。作者使用了大语言模型工具进行稿件编辑和软件实现。 作者审阅全部文本、代码、分析、结论和引用，并对其承担责任。 只有当每个裁判对影响其评分标准的变化作出可靠响应时，其决策才有用。 现有的可靠性测试方法通过施加对裁判分数具有已知预期影响的扰动来测试输入。 主流的 LLM 裁判测试框架将人工编写的扰动方案与合成测试生成相结合，但与特定评分器相关的方案构思仍游离于自动化流程之外。 这将其使用范围限制在固定扰动和预先假定的评分器类型上。 我们提出 Sane，一个基于智能体的框架，它将随机评估器的行为要求编码为可复用的智能体指令。 给定评分器的规格、实现和代表性输入，该流程首先识别与评分器相关的能力，然后为每项能力自动推导扰动方案和预期的分数关系。 Sane 还为生成的裁判测试定义了一个与评分器无关的验证框架。 它判断每个方案是否符合评分器意图，以及每个实例化用例是否实现了该方案并支持其预期关系。 由于 Sane 为每个评分器生成量身定制的方案清单，对齐方案的数量会随着评分器的增加而增长。 在五个领域中，Sane 在相当端到端有效性下产出的经验证测试族数量是裁判可靠性框架（Jrh）的 3.7 倍，并且在每个领域都能检测出评分器缺陷，包括专业性和毒性领域，而 Jrh 在这些领域均未检测出任何缺陷。 在忠实性方面，Sane 在裁判排名中实现了很强的人类一致性：其测试套件分数对 11 个裁判模型的排名与人类标注的 FaithBench 表现保持一致（Spearman ρ = 0.852 \rho=0.852），而 Jrh 则不然（ρ = 0.100 \rho=0.100）。

paragraphs.en: LLM judges now assign benchmark scores, curate supervised fine-tuning data, provide preference and reward signals for post-training, and inform deployment gates for models and prompts ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Gu et al., 2024 ) . Their decisions are useful only when a scoring implementation measures its stated criterion reliably. Agreement with human annotations on a held-out benchmark provides important evidence, but an aggregate agreement score does not characterize how a judge responds to input variations that should preserve or alter that criterion. Behavioral testing applies controlled changes to characterize these responses before comparable input variation occurs in deployment.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 裁判目前承担着为基准测试打分、整理监督微调数据、为后训练提供偏好和奖励信号，以及为模型和提示词的部署把关等任务（Zheng et al., 2023；Liu et al., 2023；Gu et al., 2024）。 只有当评分实现能够可靠地度量其声称的标准时，裁判的决策才是有用的。 与留出基准上的人类标注的一致性提供了重要证据，但总体一致性分数无法刻画裁判在面对那些应当保持或改变该标准的输入变化时的反应。 行为测试通过施加受控的变化来刻画这些反应，以便在部署中出现类似输入变化之前完成评估。

paragraphs.en: Behavioral testing evaluates whether a model satisfies focused, task-relevant behavioral properties rather than only summarizing its average performance on held-out data. It treats the model as a black box and evaluates its responses to targeted examples and controlled input changes. These tests primarily use two categories: minimum functionality tests, and metamorphic tests with invariance or directional expectations. Minimum functionality tests evaluate individual capabilities on targeted examples. Invariance and directional tests state whether outputs should remain unchanged or move in an expected direction after controlled input transformations ( Ribeiro et al., 2020 ) . In a reference-free setting, metamorphic testing specifies the relation that should hold between scorer outputs before and after a controlled input transformation ( Chen et al., 1998 ; Segura et al., 2016 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 行为测试评估的是模型是否满足聚焦的、与任务相关的行为属性，而不是仅仅总结其在保留数据上的平均表现。 它将模型视为黑盒，通过针对性示例和受控输入变化来评估其响应。 这些测试主要使用两类：最小功能测试，以及带有不变性或方向性期望的变形测试。 最小功能测试在针对性示例上评估单项能力。 不变性测试和方向性测试规定，在受控输入变换之后，输出应保持不变或朝预期方向变化（ Ribeiro et al., 2020 ）。 在无参考的设定下，变形测试规定评分器输出在受控输入变换前后应满足的关系（ Chen et al., 1998 ; Segura et al., 2016 ）。

paragraphs.en: A fixed recipe library works when each selected transformation has the same interpretation for every scorer to which it is applied. This condition does not hold in general. Formatting changes may be irrelevant to a faithfulness scorer but directly relevant to a professionalism scorer. Adding relevant detail should reduce a concision score, but increase a coverage score when the detail supplies missing salient information. A generic verbosity recipe cannot assign one expected relation to both. The required perturbation and score relation therefore depend on the scorer specification, its output contract, and the data being evaluated.

paragraphs.en: We introduce Sane , a reference-free agent-based framework that automates capability identification, scorer-specific recipe ideation, test-case generation, and validation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Sane，一个无需参考答案、基于智能体的框架，用于自动化能力识别、评分器专属方案构思、测试用例生成与验证。

paragraphs.en: Sane organizes testing around six fixed behavioral requirements: monotonicity, subadditivity, repeatability, robustness, dynamic range, and calibration. It encodes these requirements as reusable agent instructions. The requirements remain fixed across scorers, while the capabilities, perturbations, and expected relations that operationalize them depend on scorer intent. For each scorer, the agent reads the specification, implementation, and representative inputs, identifies capabilities pertinent to the scoring criterion, and ideates recipes and expected relations for each capability. Sane next instantiates test cases for each recipe and validates the complete progression from design to execution: whether the recipe agrees with scorer intent, whether the generated text realizes the requested perturbation, and whether the expected relation applies to the realized instance. Behavioral testing and metamorphic testing are well-explored foundations of Sane . We do not claim novelty in their behavioral requirements or relation types. Our contribution replaces human-authored recipe design with an agent that determines how general behavioral requirements apply to each scorer and derives the corresponding perturbations and expected relations to target its specific scoring domain. Since our framework makes no assumptions about scorer type, the same procedure could be applied to multi-agent evaluators and statistical metrics in addition to single-model LLM judges; we do not evaluate these scorer types here.
paragraphs.zh: Sane 将测试组织围绕六项固定的行为要求展开：单调性、次可加性、可重复性、鲁棒性、动态范围和校准。 它将这些要求编码为可复用的智能体指令。 这些要求在各评分器之间保持固定，而将其实例化的能力、扰动和预期关系则取决于评分器的意图。 对于每个评分器，智能体会阅读规范、实现和代表性输入，识别与评分标准相关的能力，并为每种能力构思测试配方及预期关系。 Sane 接着为每个测试配方实例化测试用例，并验证从设计到执行的完整流程：测试配方是否契合评分器意图，生成的文本是否实现了所请求的扰动，以及预期关系是否适用于已实现的实例。 行为测试和蜕变测试是 Sane 已被充分研究的基础。 我们并不声称在其行为要求或关系类型上具有新颖性。 我们的贡献在于用智能体取代人工编写的测试配方设计，由该智能体确定一般性行为要求如何应用于每个评分器，并推导出针对其特定评分领域的相应扰动和预期关系。 由于我们的框架对评分器类型不作任何假设，因此同一流程除了可应用于单模型 LLM 裁判之外，还可应用于多智能体评估器和统计指标；我们在此并未评估这些评分器类型。

sents.en: For each scorer, the agent reads the specification, implementation, and representative inputs, identifies capabilities pertinent to the scoring criterion, and ideates recipes and expected relations for each capability.
sents.zh: 对于每个评分器，智能体会阅读规范、实现和代表性输入，识别与评分标准相关的能力，并为每种能力构思测试配方及预期关系。

sents.en: Sane next instantiates test cases for each recipe and validates the complete progression from design to execution: whether the recipe agrees with scorer intent, whether the generated text realizes the requested perturbation, and whether the expected relation applies to the realized instance.
sents.zh: Sane 接着为每个测试配方实例化测试用例，并验证从设计到执行的完整流程：测试配方是否契合评分器意图，生成的文本是否实现了所请求的扰动，以及预期关系是否适用于已实现的实例。

sents.en: Behavioral testing and metamorphic testing are well-explored foundations of Sane .
sents.zh: 行为测试和蜕变测试是 Sane 已被充分研究的基础。

sents.en: We do not claim novelty in their behavioral requirements or relation types.
sents.zh: 我们并不声称在其行为要求或关系类型上具有新颖性。

sents.en: Our contribution replaces human-authored recipe design with an agent that determines how general behavioral requirements apply to each scorer and derives the corresponding perturbations and expected relations to target its specific scoring domain.
sents.zh: 我们的贡献在于用智能体取代人工编写的测试配方设计，由该智能体确定一般性行为要求如何应用于每个评分器，并推导出针对其特定评分领域的相应扰动和预期关系。

sents.en: Since our framework makes no assumptions about scorer type, the same procedure could be applied to multi-agent evaluators and statistical metrics in addition to single-model LLM judges; we do not evaluate these scorer types here.
sents.zh: 由于我们的框架对评分器类型不作任何假设，因此同一流程除了可应用于单模型 LLM 裁判之外，还可应用于多智能体评估器和统计指标；我们在此并未评估这些评分器类型。

Figure 1 compares the two harness architectures and their automation boundaries. paragraphs.en: We make four contributions. First, we automate the scorer-specific reasoning required to translate fixed general behavioral requirements into capabilities, perturbations, and expected relations. This design expands the aligned recipe inventory as scorers are added. Second, we define a formal, scorer-independent validation framework that separates recipe alignment, perturbation realization, and instance-level relation applicability. Third, we show that Sane detects scorer deficiencies with tests adapted to faithfulness, fluency, coherence, professionalism, and toxicity, including scorer-dependent expected relations that Jrh ’s fixed recipes did not express. Fourth, we evaluate human alignment at the judge-ranking level and find that Sane ’s faithfulness test suite ranks 11 judge models consistently with human-labeled FaithBench performance. Model-level rank concordance is the relevant unit because we evaluate LLM judges themselves, not individual model outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们做出了四项贡献。 首先，我们自动化了将固定的通用行为要求转化为能力、扰动和预期关系所需的评分器特定推理。 这种设计在评分器增加时扩展了对齐配方清单。 其次，我们定义了一个正式的、与评分器无关的验证框架，将配方对齐、扰动实现和实例级关系适用性分离开来。 第三，我们展示了 Sane 通过针对忠实度、流畅性、连贯性、专业性和毒性的测试检测评分器缺陷，包括 Jrh 的固定配方未能表达的依赖评分器的预期关系。 第四，我们在裁判排名层面评估了与人类的一致性，发现 Sane 的忠实度测试套件对 11 个裁判模型的排名与人工标注的 FaithBench 性能一致。 模型级排名一致性是相关的评估单元，因为我们评估的是 LLM 裁判本身，而不是单个模型输出。

paragraphs.en: Behavioral testing evaluates focused, task-relevant properties through targeted examples and controlled input changes rather than relying only on aggregate held-out performance. CheckList adapted this approach to NLP through a fixed, human-authored matrix of linguistic capabilities and three test types: minimum functionality, invariance, and directional expectation ( Ribeiro et al., 2020 ) . AdaTest later used language models to propose tests within a user-guided topic tree. Users select valid suggestions and organize the tree to direct subsequent generation ( Ribeiro and Lundberg, 2022 ) . Recent systems automate more aspects of test-case construction. Ferrando et al. (2023) generate source sentences and candidate translations for predefined machine-translation capabilities. SynthEval uses controlled language-model generation to find difficult cases, after which experts identify recurring failures and manually design test templates ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) . These methods reduce the cost of instantiating and expanding tests, but retain human selection of capabilities, topics, or templates. SANE automates the preceding scorer-specific decisions: it identifies pertinent capabilities and derives recipes from the scorer specification, implementation, and representative inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 行为测试通过针对性的示例和受控的输入变化来评估聚焦的、与任务相关的属性，而不是仅仅依赖聚合的留出集性能。 CheckList 将这一方法引入 NLP，采用一个固定的、由人工编写的语言能力矩阵和三种测试类型：最小功能测试、不变性测试和方向性期望测试（Ribeiro et al., 2020）。 AdaTest 随后利用语言模型在用户引导的主题树中提出测试。 用户筛选有效的建议并对树进行组织，以引导后续的生成（Ribeiro and Lundberg, 2022）。 最近的系统将测试用例构建的更多环节自动化。Ferrando et al. （2023）为预定义的机器翻译能力生成源句子和候选译文。 SynthEval 使用受控的语言模型生成来寻找困难案例，随后由专家识别反复出现的失败并手工设计测试模板（Zhao et al., 2024）。 这些方法降低了实例化和扩展测试的成本，但仍需人工选择能力、主题或模板。 SANE 将上述针对特定评分器的决策自动化：它识别相关的能力，并从评分器的规范、实现和代表性输入中推导出配方。

paragraphs.en: Metamorphic testing addresses the oracle problem by specifying relations that should hold between source and follow-up executions ( Chen et al., 1998 ; Segura et al., 2016 ) . Relation identification, input transformation, follow-up generation, and relation checking are separate parts of this process. LLM-based systems now automate several of them. MR-Adopt recovers a reusable input transformation from a developer-written test that already contains a source input, follow-up input, and output assertion ( Xu et al., 2024 ) . Cho et al. (2025) collect 191 relations from prior NLP research and execute 38 of them across four LLMs, demonstrating the breadth of applicable relations while retaining a curated relation inventory. Cañizares et al. (2026) propose a domain-independent assistant that infers new relations and generates follow-up cases, with validation and repair stages, for three software domains. Their system operationalizes relations within a metamorphic-testing environment and accepts domain context through a conversational interface. These results establish LLM assistance for relation inference and follow-up validation outside judge testing. SANE instead defines and evaluates a judge-specific entry point: given an arbitrary scorer, it derives the capabilities, recipes, perturbations, and expected score relations required to test that scorer.

paragraphs.en: LLM judges can agree well with human preferences on summarization, dialogue, and pairwise model comparison ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ) . Agreement with human annotations does not, by itself, establish that a judge measures its stated criterion consistently. Measurement theory separates validity, which concerns whether scores represent the intended construct, from reliability, which concerns variation under repeated application of the measurement procedure ( Chehbouni et al., 2025 ) . Empirical work confirms that these questions require separate tests. Lee et al. (2025) measure self-consistency and agreement across scoring scales, while Rating Roulette measures intra-rater reliability across repeated calls ( Haldar and Hockenmaier, 2025 ) . Recent work on contemporary proprietary judges shows that an overconfidence advisory and single-call self-debate improve the calibration and score-distribution spread of verbalized confidence ( Hsiao, 2026 ) . Thakur et al. (2025) show that percent agreement can conceal large score differences and report sensitivity to prompt complexity and lenient scoring. This line of work establishes repeated execution, prompt variation, scale choice, and criterion validity as distinct properties of a judge as a measurement instrument.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 判别器在摘要、对话和成对模型比较任务上能与人类偏好高度一致 ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ) 。 与人类标注的一致性本身并不能证明判别器在测量其声称的标准时具有一致性。 测量理论区分了效度（关注分数是否代表目标构念）与信度（关注测量程序在重复应用时的变异） ( Chehbouni et al., 2025 ) 。 实证研究表明这些问题需要分别检验。Lee et al. (2025) 测量了自一致性以及跨评分尺度的一致性，而 Rating Roulette 则测量了跨重复调用的评分者内信度 ( Haldar and Hockenmaier, 2025 ) 。 近期针对当代商业判别器的研究表明，过度自信提示和单次调用自我辩论可以改善言语化置信度的校准和分数分布的离散程度 ( Hsiao, 2026 ) 。Thakur et al. (2025) 表明百分比一致性可能掩盖较大的分数差异，并报告了对提示复杂度以及宽松评分的敏感性。 这一工作路线将重复执行、提示变化、量表选择和标准效度确立为判别器作为测量工具的不同属性。

sents.en: Measurement theory separates validity, which concerns whether scores represent the intended construct, from reliability, which concerns variation under repeated application of the measurement procedure ( Chehbouni et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 测量理论区分了效度（关注分数是否代表目标构念）与信度（关注测量程序在重复应用时的变异） ( Chehbouni et al., 2025 ) 。

sents.en: Empirical work confirms that these questions require separate tests. Lee et al.

sents.en: (2025) measure self-consistency and agreement across scoring scales, while Rating Roulette measures intra-rater reliability across repeated calls ( Haldar and Hockenmaier, 2025 ) .

sents.en: Recent work on contemporary proprietary judges shows that an overconfidence advisory and single-call self-debate improve the calibration and score-distribution spread of verbalized confidence ( Hsiao, 2026 ) . Thakur et al.

paragraphs.en: Judge-specific test suites convert these reliability questions into controlled evaluations. FBI defines 22 human-designed perturbation categories across factuality, instruction following, long-form coherence, and reasoning. It generates 2,400 cases and manually validates every perturbation ( Doddapaneni et al., 2024 ) . CALM defines 12 judge biases and automates principle-guided response modifications for each category ( Ye et al., 2025 ) . Jrh generates and validates cases for a fixed suite covering label changes, formatting invariance, semantic paraphrase, verbosity, stochastic stability, and ordinal calibration ( Dev et al., 2026 ) . It also supports human review before judge execution and is the closest engineering comparison to SANE. CheckList, FBI, CALM, and JRH demonstrate the value of targeted tests and automatic perturbation generation. In each system, the test inventory remains fixed after its authors define the capabilities, test types, bias categories, or recipes.
paragraphs.zh: 针对特定评审器的测试套件将这些可靠性问题转化为受控评估。 FBI 定义了涵盖事实性、指令遵循、长文连贯性和推理的 22 个人工设计的扰动类别。 它生成 2,400 个用例，并对每个扰动进行人工验证（ Doddapaneni et al., 2024 ）。 CALM 定义了 12 种评审器偏差，并针对每个类别自动化生成基于原则引导的响应修改（ Ye et al., 2025 ）。 Jrh 为一个固定套件生成并验证用例，该套件涵盖标签更改、格式不变性、语义改写、冗长性、随机稳定性和序数校准（ Dev et al., 2026 ）。 它还支持在智能体执行前进行人工审查，是与 SANE 最接近的工程对比方案。 CheckList、FBI、CALM 和 JRH 展示了针对性测试和自动扰动生成的价值。 在每个系统中，测试清单在作者定义了能力、测试类型、偏差类别或配方之后就保持固定。

paragraphs.en: SANE automates scorer-specific metamorphic test design. Its reusable behavioral requirements remain constant. The agent then determines how they apply to each scorer and produces a new recipe inventory. SANE then separates three validity questions: whether a recipe agrees with scorer intent, whether a generated case realizes the recipe, and whether the expected relation applies to that realized case. Our contribution is an agent pipeline that reasons from general behavioral requirements to derive scorer-specific capabilities, metamorphic recipes, and expected relations, then explicitly accounts for validity from candidate recipe to validated test family.
paragraphs.zh: SANE 自动化了针对特定评分器的蜕变测试设计。 其可复用的行为需求保持不变。 智能体随后确定这些需求如何应用于每个评分器，并生成新的配方清单。 SANE 进而区分三个有效性问题：配方是否与评分器意图一致，生成的用例是否实现了该配方，以及预期关系是否适用于该已实现的用例。 我们的贡献是一个智能体流水线，它从一般行为需求出发进行推理，推导出针对特定评分器的能力、蜕变配方和预期关系，然后从候选配方到经验证的测试族显式地考虑有效性。

paragraphs.en: Given a scorer specification and representative examples, Sane performs two generation steps, as shown in Figure 1 . First, the agent identifies key capabilities implied by the scorer and derives perturbation recipes that target them. Each recipe states a perturbation and its expected effect on scorer outputs. Second, the agent instantiates test cases intended to realize each recipe’s perturbation. A recipe together with its generated test cases is a candidate test family . The collection of a scorer’s candidate test families is its candidate test suite .
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个评分器规范和代表性示例，如图 1 所示，Sane 执行两个生成步骤。 首先，智能体识别评分器所隐含的关键能力，并推导出针对这些能力的扰动配方。 每个配方陈述一种扰动及其对评分器输出的预期影响。 其次，智能体实例化测试用例，以实现每个配方所述的扰动。 一个配方连同其生成的测试用例构成一个候选测试族。 一个评分器的所有候选测试族的集合构成其候选测试套件。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments proceed in three phases. First, test-suite preparation applies the generation and validation procedures from Section 3: we generate candidate test families, evaluate the three oracle conditions in Equations 4 – 6 , and retain joint-valid test cases and validated families (Figures 1 , 3 , and 4 ). Second, we execute the prepared test cases against their target scorers and identify cases whose expected relations do not hold. Because oracle validation requires agreement on alignment, realization, and applicability, we interpret a violated relation as a deficiency in the targeted capability and call it a fault . A test case is fault detecting when its scorer outputs violate the expected relation, and a validated family is fault detecting when at least one joint-valid case detects a fault. Third, we measure human alignment in the form of whether harness pass rates rank judge models consistently with an independent human-labeled benchmark. These phases test whether modern agents can derive scorer-aligned metamorphic recipes, whether those recipes yield validated and fault-detecting test families, and whether the resulting test suites differentiate judge models consistently with human evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验分三个阶段进行。 首先，测试套件准备阶段应用第 3 节中的生成与验证流程：我们生成候选测试族，评估公式 4–6 中的三个判定条件（oracle 条件），并保留联合有效的测试用例以及通过验证的测试族（图 1、3 和 4）。 其次，我们针对相应的目标评分器执行准备好的测试用例，并识别出期望关系不成立的用例。 由于判定条件验证要求在对齐、实现和适用性上达成一致，我们将被违反的关系解释为目标能力上的缺陷，并将其称为故障（fault）。 当一个测试用例的评分器输出违反了期望关系时，该用例即具有故障检测能力；当一个已验证测试族中至少有一个联合有效用例检测到故障时，该测试族即具有故障检测能力。 第三，我们以测试框架通过率是否能与独立的人工标注基准一致地对评判模型进行排序为形式，来衡量与人类的对齐程度。 这些阶段旨在检验：现代智能体能否推导出与评分器对齐的蜕变测试配方，这些配方能否产生已验证且能检测故障的测试族，以及由此得到的测试套件能否依据人类证据一致地区分评判模型。

paragraphs.en: The experiment covers faithfulness, fluency, coherence, professionalism, and toxicity scorers. The primary analysis excludes repeatability because identical-input replication does not require scorer-specific text and would not measure recipe adaptation.

paragraphs.en: Oracle judges measure each of the three criteria necessary for a joint-valid test case in Equations 4 – 6 . The recipe oracle receives the scorer specification, generated recipe, and expected relation. The case oracle receives the scorer specification, original and perturbed text, recipe, and expected relation. It predicts recipe realization and relation applicability separately. We collect three independent GPT-5.2 predictions for each decision and use majority voting over the panel. The oracle inputs use the same fields for Sane and Jrh and include generated text verbatim. We set n = 10 n=10 for every aligned scorer-recipe pair, which gives τ = 6 \tau=6 under the strict-majority family rule. Appendix C evaluates every threshold from τ = 5 \tau=5 through τ = 10 \tau=10 and shows that the central family-count and cross-domain conclusions hold throughout. This choice satisfies budget constraints while retaining enough repeated cases per recipe to estimate each judge’s criterion-specific test-suite pass rate. Case-level fault rates and judge-ranking agreement use every joint-valid sampled case from aligned recipes, including cases from families below the family threshold. The family threshold measures consistency across generated cases; it does not invalidate a case that independently passes all three oracle decisions. Cases with J t , r = 0 J_{t,r}=0 do not contribute to either analysis. We count unresolved oracle predictions as invalid and unresolved scorer predictions as not fault detecting, yielding conservative point estimates.

paragraphs.en: Our meta-evaluation asks whether validated test suites differentiate judge models according to independent human evidence. We select faithfulness as a target domain because JRH’s fixed recipes include applicable faithfulness transformations, making the domain representable by both harnesses. At the judge-model level, we measure two independent summaries of scorer quality. FaithBench AUROC summarizes how well the model’s continuous faithfulness scores distinguish human-labeled faithful and unfaithful examples ( Bao et al., 2025 ) , while each harness’s pass rate summarizes how often the model satisfies expected relations over joint-valid faithfulness test cases. The faithfulness scorer elicits verbalized confidence using an overconfidence advisory and single-call self-debate ( Hsiao, 2026 ) . We beta-calibrate the resulting scores to probabilities on [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] using parameters fit on labeled AggreFact data separate from FaithBench. These metrics measure different quantities, so we do not compare their numerical values. We instead measure agreement between the judge-model rankings they induce using Spearman ρ \rho and Kendall τ b \tau_{b} . The primary panel contains 11 models and excludes Opus 5, which generated both test corpora. GPT-5.2, which serves as the validation oracle, is also not a panel member. Panel results are computed from 777 FaithBench examples and the downsampled faithfulness test sets, which comprise 165 Sane and 55 Jrh joint-valid test cases. We use a two-sided exact permutation test for Spearman ρ \rho .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的元评估旨在探究经过验证的测试套件能否依据独立的人类证据区分裁判模型。 我们选择忠实度作为目标领域，因为 JRH 的固定配方包含适用的忠实度转换，使得该领域可以被两个测试框架所表示。 在裁判模型层面，我们测量评分器质量的两个独立汇总指标。 FaithBench AUROC 汇总了模型的连续忠实度分数区分人类标注的忠实与不忠实示例的能力（Bao et al., 2025），而每个测试框架的通过率则汇总了模型在联合有效的忠实度测试用例上满足预期关系的频率。 该忠实度评分器使用过度自信提示和单次调用自我辩论来引出言语化置信度（Hsiao, 2026）。 我们使用在独立于 FaithBench 的已标注 AggreFact 数据上拟合的参数，将所得分数 beta 校准为 [0,1] 区间内的概率。 这些指标测量的是不同的量，因此我们不比较它们的数值。 我们转而使用 Spearman ρ 和 Kendall τ_b 来测量它们所诱导的裁判模型排名之间的一致性。 主面板包含 11 个模型，并排除了 Opus 5，因为两个测试语料库均由其生成。 作为验证 oracle 的 GPT-5.2 也不是面板成员。 面板结果基于 777 个 FaithBench 示例以及下采样的忠实度测试集计算，后者包含 165 个 Sane 和 55 个 Jrh 联合有效测试用例。 我们对 Spearman ρ 使用双侧精确置换检验。

paragraphs.en: Both harnesses are regenerated with the same model, so the comparison controls for generator capability. What remains open is whether the absolute generation and realization rates transfer to weaker agent models. While GPT-5.2 panels validate recipes and test cases at scale, human annotation would provide an independent estimate of oracle error, which may influence reported scorer-deficiency counts. Judge-ranking alignment is evaluated for faithfulness, the criterion supported by both harnesses and an independent human-labeled benchmark. Extending this analysis requires comparable benchmarks for other scorer criteria.

paragraphs.en: Sane automates scorer-specific metamorphic recipe ideation from general behavioral requirements and validates both recipes and generated cases before test execution. Across five scorers, this procedure produces more aligned, validated, and fault-detecting test families than Jrh , the leading open-source harness for judge reliability. On faithfulness, Sane test-suite scores provide human-aligned differentiation of judge models, supporting automated scorer-specific testing as a practical method for LLM-judge reliability.
